disclaimer: This is a local, evidence-grounded CS research ethics pre-review. It does not make final ethical, legal, compliance, or IRB determinations. Findings should be discussed with an advisor or appropriate review body, especially where context is missing.

advisor_or_irb_questions: Who is affected by model outputs?
What deployment constraints and human review steps exist?
Is there a model card documenting intended use, limitations, and fairness/bias evaluation?

evidence.snippet:
A recommender system ranks content to maximize engagement. Deployment boundaries and manipulation risks are not documented.
Matched: recommender system

missing_context: Intended deployment context, evaluation by subgroup, and whether outputs affect people.
recommended_mitigations: Create or update a model card.
Document fairness and bias evaluation methods.
Set deployment boundaries and human-review expectations.
findings.title: Fairness, profiling, or deployment harm risk
findings.why_it_matters: ML systems may classify, rank, profile, recommend to, or otherwise affect people.

advisor_or_irb_questions: What license applies to the code?
What terms apply to collected or derived data?

evidence.reason: No code or dataset license documentation was detected.

missing_context: Code license, dataset source terms, and redistribution permissions.
recommended_mitigations: Document dataset source terms and redistribution limits.
Avoid redistributing data unless terms permit it.
findings.title: License or dataset redistribution terms are unclear
findings.why_it_matters: Repository evidence leaves code, data, or platform redistribution terms unclear.

global_missing_context: Project purpose, population, data provenance, consent/notice process, and intended release/deployment should be clarified when not documented.
safe_release_checklist: Confirm the project purpose, affected populations, and deployment context are documented.
Review whether data collection aligns with reasonable expectations and platform terms.
Remove, aggregate, or protect direct identifiers and sensitive quasi-identifiers.
Define data retention, deletion, access control, and sharing limits.
Avoid public release of raw sensitive or identifiable records.
Document known limitations, misuse risks, and appropriate use boundaries.
Prepare responsible disclosure steps for security-sensitive work.
Rotate any exposed credentials and keep secrets out of reports and commits.
